overview_description: Read overview reports for accounts, invoices, orders, purchases, payments and refunds over a date range.
intro: Reports return overview figures as a list of dated entries over a period: accounts, invoices, orders, purchase invoices, purchase orders, payments and refunds, and purchase payments and refunds. Each report is a single read with a date range. This area has 7 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Every report comes back under `report`.** Inside it, one key names the report, such as `accounts` holding an `account_overview` list.
**Choose the period with `date_range`.** Send `date_range=custom` with `from` and `to` dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`; an unrecognised `date_range` returns `400`.
**A report has a default period.** Called with no parameters, it gives 7 dated entries, the same count as a seven day `custom` range.
**Amounts and counts are strings.** Fields such as `amount`, `count`, `net_gain` and `invoice_total` are JSON strings, not numbers.

**A report can take up to 90 seconds.** Set `timeout_seconds` (Python), `timeoutSeconds` (JavaScript, PHP, .NET, Java, Dart) or `TimeoutSeconds` (Go) to 120 in the configuration you register, as shown in [Authentication](/authentication#set-up-a-client).

endpoints.title: Retrieve the account overview report
endpoints.summary: Returns new, cancelled, reactivated and deleted account counts, with the net gain, for each dated entry in a period.
endpoints.description: The report is under `report.accounts.account_overview`, one entry per `date` with `new`, `cancelled`, `reactivated`, `deleted` and `net_gain`. Set `date_range` to `custom` and pass `from` and `to`; with no parameters, the report covers a default period of 7 dated entries.

parameters.name: date_range
parameters.description: The reporting period. `custom` uses `from` and `to`; an unrecognised value returns `400`. Without it, a default period applies.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day of a `custom` period, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day of a `custom` period, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Each entry has a `date`, an `invoice_total`, and an `amount` and `count` for `new`, `cancelled`, `reactivated`, `voided`, `amended` and `net_gain`. Set `date_range` to `custom` and pass `from` and `to`; with no parameters, the report covers a default period of 7 dated entries.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day of a `custom` period, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day of a `custom` period, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve the purchase payment and refund overview report
